start.dialog: The Emperor Icefish only swims beneath the Glacier Sea during the winter solstice! Its scales are worth a king's ransom! But it takes skill, patience, and courage to catch one. The ice is thin, the water deadly cold. Want to try your luck?
start.objective: Set up an ice fishing camp on the Glacier Sea

progress.dialog: You've got a bite! But this is no ordinary fish—it's massive! The ice is cracking! You need to reel it in carefully, or you'll both fall into the freezing water!
progress.objective: Reel in the Emperor Icefish without breaking the ice

complete.dialog: The Emperor Icefish! Magnificent! The Winter Festival will feast like royalty! Here's your share of the profits—and this Ice Fishing Spear! It never misses when thrown at aquatic targets!

party_comments.kade: I fought a fish for thirty minutes! What a battle!
party_comments.twist: My fingers are icicles. I may never feel warmth again.
